title: Completed pullback preserves shifts and distinguished triangles
statement: Let $u:T'\to T$ be a morphism of schemes. Fix the Noetherian adic datum $(A,I)$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], including finite perfect quotients $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$, and use its completed ring sheaves $A_W=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_W$ on the small pro-etale sites, for $W=T,T'$. Let $P_u=Lu^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ be precisely the strict-tower completed pullback of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], defined on the full subcategory of derived $I$-complete objects of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_T))$ [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. It has natural shift isomorphisms $P_u(M[r])\cong P_u(M)[r]$ for $r\in\mathbf Z$, satisfying the shift unit and composition identities. For every ambient distinguished triangle $M\to N\to Q\to M[1]$ whose three vertices are derived $I$-complete, the image triangle, with final arrow followed by this shift comparison, is distinguished in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_{T'}))$ [def-weil-triangulated-category]. This assertion concerns the specified reduction-tower, derived tower pullback and derived inverse limit construction; it assumes no constructibility or noetherianity of the schemes.
